rule: Use the common process and full history. Compare each proposal structurally with the nearest previous candidate: object, core relation/action, contrast, prediction, independent unit. Seek useful new families or genuine discriminating refinements, not cosmetic distance. Self-report the four quality gates honestly. The broker selects lexicographically by all four quality gates passed, history_relation (new_family/no_history=2, refinement=1, repeat=0), feasible_with_current_data, then lowest candidate index. Treat implementation errors, missing data, statistical uncertainty, contradicted predictions and literature overlap differently when choosing repair, measure, test, refine or explore. Never exclude an entire family solely because of one noisy or failed computation.
